scope: Independent source and component review. No compiled latest NAND timing or exact board acceptance claim.
rust_tests: 16 pass, including all4096 single-bit ECC locations

findings.detail: Data-only backing mem_oob branch at OOB-only column2050 computes source pointer io-2 and wrong spare offset in legacy nand_blk_write. New timing bounds allow legal totalpage+OOB range. Fix branch or reject this backing layout; compiled OOB boundaries required.
Exposed chip-id property permits16-bit and small-page NAND despite x8 five-cycle large-page controller contract. Reject unsupported identity/geometry in realize.

Controller reset restores chip deadline only for program/erase. READ25us and RESET5us intervals exist only in Rust and can be lost after controller reset. Complete busy/reset behavior remains unverified.

other_observations: Exact valid command/end tuples and duplicate-confirm rejection prevent malformed destructive sequences.
Pending write data separated from status bytes; program/erase delayed commit and NAND reset abort are explicit fixture semantics, not physical power-loss calibration.
Current tests prove persistence only across device reset, not process restart or filesystem durable flush.
ECC bit-position parity matches archived correction contract. Page-size/mode generality beyond current selected fixture is not established.
